title: Zeus Arc GTS Heatsink
description: The Zeus Arc GTS Heat Sink is redesigned for maximum airflow and maximum cooling efficiency. Designed for use with the new Zeus Arc GTS, this gold-plated heat sink works to remove the heat from your vapor while preserving the flavor of your herbs. If you require a replacement, this is identical to the Heat Sink you originally received with your Zeus Arc GTS.
